             (id, org_id, course_id, module_id, position, kind, ref_id, url, title,
              created_at, updated_at)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9,
                 timestamptz 'epoch' + $10::bigint * interval '1 microsecond',
                 timestamptz 'epoch' + $10::bigint * interval '1 microsecond')
